verdict.rationale: New Relic documents recording APM deployment markers through its official CLI, which can run in CI/CD pipelines. That is first-party release tracking. The evidence does not show how markers are overlaid on performance data to correlate regressions, and configuration-change tracking is not documented at all. Missing for 10: documented correlation of deploy markers with performance regressions (e.g., charts or impact analysis), tracking of configuration and other non-deploy changes, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can correlate regressions with deploys and configuration changes via release or change tracking

citations.quote: Deployment Markers: Easily record an APM Application deployment within New Relic.
You can use the New Relic CLI to manage entity tags, define workloads, record deployment markers, and much more.
